constraints: The generated license file is only valid for the specific application referenced by mergedApp, and must be regenerated whenever that application is rebuilt.
If the Licenses folder does not already exist inside mergedApp, it is created by the command.
In non-automatic mode, if the build requires an OEM license (4D OEM XML Keys) not already installed in the building machine's Licenses folder, it must be supplied via oemLicense.

overloadMerges.note: Enumerated the documented autoLicenseTarget constants as sentinelValues instead of leaving it a bare Integer.

params.name: mergedApp
params.description: Folder containing the built application in which to embed a license.

params.name: autoLicenseTarget
params.description: Target platform for automatic license selection.

sentinelValues.meaning: 4D Volume Desktop -- create a license for a 4D single-user application
4D Server -- create a license for a 4D Server application

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Automatic mode: lets 4D find and embed the most appropriate license for the given autoLicenseTarget platform.

discriminatedBy.rule: Integer (autoLicenseTarget) -- automatic license selection for the named platform target.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Manual mode: embeds the license(s) explicitly designated by buildLicense (and, if an OEM license is required and not already installed, oemLicense).

discriminatedBy.rule: 4D.File (buildLicense) -- manual designation of the license file(s) to use.
